{"consolidated_memory":"## Plan Drift in infra/terraform/vpc.tf — Multiple Incidents

All incidents occurred in the same file/component (infra/terraform/vpc.tf, infrastructure side) but represent distinct occasions with different root causes and solutions. Each can be reproduced by running plan twice with no changes in between; all exhibit the signal of diffs on resources nobody edited.

### Incident 1: Non-ASCII Name Records (2026-03-04)
- **Trigger/Condition**: Only manifested for records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root Cause**: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR/Branch**: #1309 on branch fix/plan-drift-1
- **Outcome**: Job finished in 10 minutes instead of 6 hours
- **Context**: Same corner of infra/terraform/vpc.tf as earlier plan drift work

### Incident 2: v1 SDK Clients (2026-06-27)
- **Trigger/Condition**: Only manifested for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root Cause**: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- **Fix**: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- **PR/Branch**: #2397 on branch fix/plan-drift-2
- **Outcome**: 75 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- **Context**: Same corner of infra/terraform/vpc.tf as earlier plan drift work

### Incident 3: Large Payloads (2026-08-06)
- **Trigger/Condition**: Only manifested for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- **Root Cause**: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- **Fix**: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- **PR/Branch**: #8707 on branch fix/plan-drift-3
- **Outcome**: Reclaimed 33 GB of blob storage
- **Context**: Same corner of infra/terraform/vpc.tf as earlier plan drift work"}
